content.text: Name each of these things visible in the image with one short noun phrase: cup, block, marker. Skip a kind that is not visible. A first attempt gave: cup: 'white cup'; block: 'blue cube'; marker: 'red cylinder'. These did not match exactly one object: 'white cup' (cup) matched 0 objects; 'red cylinder' (marker) matched 0 objects. Give new phrases for those kinds only.

request.instructions:
You name objects in an image so that a segmentation model can find them.
The segmentation model matches short concrete noun phrases: colour plus
shape works best ("blue cube", "white square box", "red cylinder"). Do not
write instructions or questions, do not use "and", commas, negation or
positions ("on the left"). Each phrase must pick out exactly one thing in the
image.

phrase.description: 2-4 word noun phrase: colour + shape, e.g. 'blue cube'

response.text: {"objects": [{"kind": "cup", "phrase": "white cylinder", "why": "held white object has cylindrical shape"}, {"kind": "marker", "phrase": "orange cylinder", "why": "small orange object has cylindrical shape"}]}
